summary: Broadcom Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 2.02, 8.01, 9.01) reporting Q2 FY2026 financial results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.65 per share, payable June 30, 2026 to holders of record June 22, 2026. Revenue was $22.187 billion (up 48% YoY) with GAAP EPS $1.91 and non-GAAP EPS $2.44. Free cash flow reached $10.262 billion (46% of revenue). The dividend is a routine capital return event; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is involved. Watch for continued dividend growth or special dividends given strong cash generation, but no risk-arb angle applies.
